_notes: Shown in game as 'Consumables' (formerly Potions); ids keep the old 'potion' naming.
Default 3 potion slots (+2 with Bottle Rack). Shop price 45-64 gold x (1 + 0.15 x (act-1)).
Drop: Elites always drop a potion; normal fights 50%. No potions with Cracked Flask.

potions.name: Healing Draught
potions.description: Heal 20 HP (+10 per Act after the first). Usable anywhere.

potions.name: Volatile Flask
potions.description: Deal 20 damage to the target (×Act number).

potions.name: Iron Tonic
potions.description: Gain 15 Shield (×Act number).

potions.name: Mighty Brew
potions.description: Gain 3 Might (+2 per Act after the first).

potions.name: Purge Salts
potions.description: Cleanse every debuff from the tiles in your hand.

potions.name: Ink of Plenty
potions.description: Draw 5 tiles.

potions.name: Phoenix Feather
potions.description: Keep it in a slot. When you would die, it burns and brings you back with 30% HP. It can't be drunk.

potions.name: Energy Tonic
potions.description: Gain 2 Energy.

potions.name: Fresh Pages
potions.description: Discard your whole hand and draw a fresh 16 tiles.

potions.name: Venom Vial
potions.description: Inflict 8 Poison on the target (+4 per Act after the first).

potions.name: Blast Jar
potions.description: Deal 12 damage to ALL enemies (+6 per Act after the first).

potions.name: Shatter Draught
potions.description: Inflict Broken 3 on ALL enemies (+50% damage taken).

potions.name: Jester's Brew
potions.description: Add 2 Fragile [ ? ] Wildcard tiles to your hand (or your discard pile if your hand is full).

potions.name: Battle Cry
potions.description: Add 5 Fragile [ ! ] tiles to your hand (or your discard pile if your hand is full).

potions.name: Vanishing Powder
potions.description: Escape a normal or Elite fight. You get no reward. Doesn't work on bosses.

potions.name: Ancient Fruit
potions.description: Raise your Max HP by 5 and heal 5. Usable anywhere.

potions.name: Echo Draught
potions.description: The next word you cast this turn has its output doubled.

potions.name: Clarity Draught
potions.description: Every tile in your hand becomes Level 2 for this combat.

potions.name: Tempering Oil
potions.description: Fortify up to 4 tiles in your hand for this combat (they stay in your hand and can't be debuffed). Also cleanses them.

potions.name: Titan Serum
potions.description: Multiply your current Might by 5.

potions.name: Bastion Serum
potions.description: Multiply your current Robust by 5.

potions.name: Rage Soda
potions.description: Gain 10 Might for this turn only.

potions.name: Brick Milk
potions.description: Gain 10 Robust for this turn only.

potions.name: Cluster Bomb
potions.description: Deal 25 damage to ALL enemies.

potions.name: Rocket Pop
potions.description: Deal 50 damage to the target.

potions.name: Full Flask
potions.description: Heal 50% of your Max HP. Usable anywhere.

potions.name: Flashbang
potions.description: Stun the target: it skips its next turn.

potions.name: Overclock Chip
potions.description: Your selected weapon costs 0 Energy for the rest of this turn.

potions.name: Panacea
potions.description: Remove every debuff on you: Poison, Weaken, Broken, Curse and Frustrated.
